_comment: Evidence strength (P20). TWO axes kept separate: strength (how directly does this assert a problem?) and attribution (are we sure it is this company?). The SEC failure was attributional, not a strength problem, and one axis cannot express that.

levels.E0: Context — what they run or who they are. NEVER an opportunity on its own.
levels.E1: Inferred initiative — someone is doing something that implies a project.
levels.E2: Stated initiative — the organisation says it is doing the thing.
levels.E3: Declared requirement — the organisation says it needs a supplier.

overrides.note: Explicit buying intent, whatever the source said it was.
A stated initiative — they have said publicly that they are doing it.

attributionLevels.A_exact: The domain came from the source itself (contact email, story URL, board slug).
